goal: Simplify wallet unlocking and database migration by enforcing a single encryption key per wallet
Remove obsolete complexity from legacy multi-key handling that served no practical purpose
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support for cleaning up wallet encryption to a single master key (jeanpablojp, rkrux)
Verified by testing that nonstandard master key IDs remain backward compatible (vicjuma)
Edge case where double-encrypted blank wallets from v0.18 fail to load was dismissed as rare (jeanpablojp)
Concept approval without stated reasons (theStack, w0xlt)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it simplifies internal wallet logic that only ever uses a single key in practice
The benefit is limited to maintainers removing dead code with no functional improvement for users
